page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed from a worn scan; several accents and letters are uncertain (e.g. καλύπτω, θήπτω, σπύπτω, ϝάλῶ, ἁλῶ) and should be checked against the original. The first line "ftodio,am." is a fragment carried over from the previous page.
